verses.text: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up the mountain and sat down. His disciples came over to him.
Then he began teaching them:
“Blessed are those who know they need God, because Heaven’s Kingdom belongs to them.”
“Blessed are those who grieve; they’ll be comforted.”
“Blessed are the gentle; they’ll inherit the earth.”
“Blessed are those hungry and thirsty for what’s right; God will fill them up.”
“Blessed are the merciful; mercy will come back to them. 🤲”
“Blessed are the pure in heart; they’ll see God.”
“Blessed are the peacemakers; they’ll be called God’s children. 🕊️”
“Blessed are those persecuted for doing what’s right, because Heaven’s Kingdom belongs to them.”
“Blessed are you when people insult you, come after you, and make up all kinds of evil stories about you because of me.”
“Rejoice—be really glad—because your reward in heaven is great. The prophets before you got treated the same way.”
“You’re the salt of the earth. But if salt loses its taste, what can bring the flavor back? It’s useless then—just thrown out and trampled. 🧂”
“You’re the light of the world. A city up on a hill can’t stay hidden. ✨”
“Nobody lights a lamp and hides it under a basket. They put it on a stand, and it lights up everyone in the house.”
“In the same way, let your light shine in front of people. They’ll see the good you do and give glory to your Father in heaven.”
“Don’t think I came to scrap the Law or the Prophets. I didn’t come to scrap them; I came to fulfill them.”
“I’m telling you the truth: while heaven and earth remain, not even the tiniest letter or pen stroke will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.”
“So whoever breaks even the least of these commands and teaches others to do the same will be called least in Heaven’s Kingdom. But whoever practices and teaches them will be called great there.”
“I’m telling you, unless your righteousness goes beyond that of the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees, you won’t enter Heaven’s Kingdom.”
“You’ve heard what the people long ago were told: ‘Don’t murder; whoever murders will face judgment.’”

“But I’m telling you, anyone angry with a brother or sister without cause will face judgment. Whoever calls them ‘Raca’ must answer to the council; whoever says, ‘You fool!’ faces the fire of Gehenna.”
“So if you’re bringing your gift to the altar and remember someone has a problem with you,”
“leave your gift there by the altar, go make things right with them first, then come back and offer your gift.”
“Settle things with your opponent quickly while you’re still on the way to court. Otherwise, they may hand you over to the judge, the judge to the officer, and you’ll land in prison.”
“I’m telling you the truth: you won’t get out until you’ve paid the very last coin.”
“You’ve heard it said: ‘Don’t commit adultery.’”
“But I’m telling you, anyone who keeps looking at a woman with lust has already committed adultery with her in their heart.”
“If your right eye trips you up, tear it out and throw it away. Better for one part of you to be lost than for your whole body to be thrown into Gehenna.”
“If your right hand trips you up, cut it off and throw it away. Better for one part of you to be lost than for your whole body to go into Gehenna.”
“It was also said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a divorce certificate.’”
“But I’m telling you, anyone who divorces his wife—except because of sexual immorality—makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.”
“Again, you’ve heard what people long ago were told: ‘Don’t break your vows; keep your promises to the Lord.’”
“But I’m telling you, don’t swear oaths at all—not by heaven, because it’s God’s throne;”
“not by earth, because it’s where his feet rest; not by Jerusalem, because it’s the city of the great King.”
“Don’t swear by your own head either—you can’t make even one hair turn white or black.”
“Let your ‘Yes’ mean yes and your ‘No’ mean no. Anything beyond that comes from the evil one.”
“You’ve heard it said: ‘An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.’”
“But I’m telling you, don’t answer evil with evil. If someone strikes your right cheek, turn the other one too.”
“If someone takes you to court for your shirt, let them have your coat too.”
“If someone forces you to go one mile, go two with them.”
“Give to the person who asks you, and don’t turn away someone who wants to borrow from you.”
“You’ve heard it said: ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’”
“But I’m telling you, love your enemies. Bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat and persecute you.”
“That way, you’ll be children of your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on evil people and good people, and sends rain on those who do right and those who don’t.”
“If you love only the people who love you, what reward is that? Even tax collectors do the same.”
“If you greet only your friends, what are you doing beyond everyone else? Even tax collectors do that.”
“So be complete in love, just as your Father in heaven is complete.”
